problem: Native DOC floating shape markers inherited CPicLocation 0 from the inline JPEG. The PICF-only recognizer treated both the rounded rectangle and floating PNG as that JPEG, and similarly misidentified the converted vector group as the first PNG.
changes: Recognize inline PICF markers separately from floating shape markers. Retain a floating image reference with its story and shape ID, expose drawing_shape_id(), and refuse low-level PICF-only data access with DrawingStoreRequired.

Retain bounded OfficeArtContent when floating anchors exist, lazily index shape containers and cache each story CP-to-shape map. Resolve actual picture-frame pib references through BStore instead of using inherited CPicLocation hints. Missing/ambiguous declared references and malformed drawing graphs are errors.
Preserve existing MTEF and non-image handling. Metadata reads distinguish stored metafile bytes from decompression; source documentation now states the actual Data/PICF and drawing-store routes.

Add three native picture regressions, five unit guards and one generated missing-Data regression. Bind the previously unasserted DOC picture row, preserving partial coverage and historical status labels.

verification_scope.visual: Exactly four actual image runs at CP 76/97/143/183 resolve JPEG 83204, floating PNG 1698, stored compressed EMF 36576 and chart PNG 33196 with exact hashes. The rectangle anchor is not an image. Floating shape 1026 keeps its 2880x1620 twip square-wrapped frame despite CPicLocation hint 0.
verification_scope.picf: Native PICF offsets 0/83693/120495, block lengths 83693/36802/33443, header 68, mapping mode 100, goals and scales are exact. verification_scope.vector: Three inline descriptors remain: real PNGs at offsets 0/27990 with lengths 10853/15111 and recorded hashes, plus a 144-byte default PICF at 27846 with no image payload. It yields typed NoPicture rather than invented bytes. The floating converted-group marker no longer aliases the first PNG.
verification_scope.edits: First-paragraph edits on both native DOCs preserve ordered PICF hints, floating shape identities, kinds/hashes and explicit empty descriptor through temporary save/reopen. Successful floating resolution proves the shifted Spa anchor remains associated with its run. Inverse restores exact source bytes.
verification_scope.guards: Unit cases separate main/header identity, picture/non-picture shapes, missing stores, missing/duplicate shape IDs, malformed ranges/labels, conflicting CP mappings and the PICF-only floating refusal. A generated document with its Data stream omitted still reads its floating PNG from BStore. Existing main/header and shape/image writer suites pass.
